content: Talodalo gi hagamagedaa ina nia hagadaumee o Israel83.0 Taahili ni Asaph

content.text: Meenei God, goe hudee noho deemuu.
Goe hudee noho de ngalungalua be noho hagakila!
Mmada! O hagadaumee la gu hagalongoaa,
gei digau ala e hudi nadau wou adu gi di Goe le e hai baahi.
Digaula e haganohonoho hagammuni di nadau hai
dela belee hai baahi gi au daangada.
Digaula e hai baahi gi au daangada ala e abaaba Kooe.
Digaula e hai boloo, “Lloomoi, gidaadou gaa oho nia henua digaula,
gi de langahia Israel gaa hana hua beelaa.”
Digaula guu baba gi di nadau hai dela ne haganoho
guu buni ngaadahi bolo ginaadou e hai baahi adu gi di Goe.
Digau aanei la go digau Edom mo digau Ishmael, digau Moab mo digau Hagri,
digau Gebal, Ammon, mo Amalek, mo digau Philistia mo Tyre.
Assyria guu buni gi digaula labelaa, tenua maaloo
dela e hagamaamaa digau Ammon mo digau Moab, ala go nia hagadili o Lot.
Heia gi digaula be dau hai dela ne hai ang gi digau Midian,
mo ang gi Sisera mo Jabin i taalinga di Monowai Kishon.
Goe gu haga magedaa digaula i Endor,
gei nia huaidina digaula guu pala i hongo di gelegele.
Heia ang gi nia dagi digaula be dau hai dela ne hai ang gi Oreb mo Zeeb.
Goe haga magedaa ina nia dagi digaula huogodoo
be dau hai dela ne hai ang gi Zebah mo Zalmunna,
ala ne hai boloo, “Gidaua gaa kae tenua o God deelaa e hai tau henua.”
Meenei God, mmaga ina digaula gadoo be nia gelegele,
be nia geinga laagau ala ma ga ili go di madangi gi daha.
Hagabagia digaula gi daha gi dau madangi gono,
gadoo be di ahi ma gaa dudu nia laagau i lodo henua.
Haga madagudagu ina digaula gi dau madangi maaloo,
gadoo be di ulaula ma gaa dudu nia gonduu gii wele.
Meenei Dimaadua, heia digaula gi langaadia,
ge gi modongoohia e ginaadou bolo Goe e maaloo dangihi.
Heia digaula gi magedaa mo di mmaadagu huoloo gaa hana hua beelaa.
Heia digaula gii mmade i lodo nadau langaadia huoloo.
Heia digaula gi iloo bolo ma Kooe hua modo Gooe dela go Yihowah,
di Tagi aamua o nia mee huogodoo i henuailala.
